{{Quote|I foresee a quest in your future young Jedi. You must travel to the Dantooine system and destroy a cancerous evil growing there.|Winslau Da'k's Jedi Master|<ref name="The Last Knight">{{WEGCite|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen|story=The Last Knight}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Winslau Da'k]]. The Master was imprisoned on [[Morcanth]] by his former student, as Da'k had been corrupted to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Later, the Master was released and served his rescuers as a [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the man was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eventually attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. He trained the young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiate]] [[Winslau Da'k]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|student]].<ref name="SWGS" />

At the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the implementation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] killed the majority of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and effectively disbanded the Jedi Order.<ref name="RotS">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' comic adaptation]]</ref> Da'k and his Master survived, but at some point afterward, Da'k encountered [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who, despite the brevity of his contact with Da'k and unbeknownst to Da'k's Master, was able to corrupt the young Jedi to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of the Force. The Jedi Master was surprised and overcome by his twisted student, who imprisoned him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morcanth]], deep in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The power-mad Da'k incessantly assaulted him, attempting to attain mastery over his former master and gain knowledge before destroying him.<ref name="SWGS" />

Weakened by these assaults and desperate, the Master used the last of his diminishing power to reach out across space for help. His pleas reached the minds of a group of Force-sensitive individuals who experienced visions and [[Dream/Legends|dreams]] of the man beckoning to them from his oppressive prison. The Master was also able to communicate the name of his prison world, Morcanth; however, Morcanth had been renamed on modern [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]], and was thus a mystery to the group until they uncovered very old charts that used the original name. Upon journeying there, the group discovered the planet was located in disputed territory in a [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old war being waged by three local starfaring [[Species/Legends|species]], none of which recognized neutrality in their conflict. The group evaded the warring parties, neutralized Da'k's bevy of guards, and finally overcame Winslau Da'k himself, freeing the Master.<ref name="SWGS" />

In gratitude, the Master offered to become an instructor and advisor for the Force-sensitive individuals who freed him from his prison. His tasks for the group led to them experiencing additional adventures, including at least two forays to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during [[Dorian passion fruit]] season to thwart alleged evil there.<ref name="SWGS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Why is there always an evil on Dantooine when the passion fruits are ripe?|A student of the Master|<ref name="The Last Knight" />}}
The Master was an aging male. He enjoyed Dorian passion fruit, and at least one of his rescuers/students was suspicious regarding the timing of their missions to Dantooine consistently coinciding with passion fruit season.<ref name="SWGS" />
